about: Where lyrics show an instrumental gap. Android's behaviour, chosen by the owner on 2026-11-22. Timed lines (TTML, QRC, word-synced): a gap at 0 when the first line starts 4 s in or later; a gap at a line's sung end (its last word, or its end without words, extended by background vocals) when that end is known and 4 s or more pass before the next line; never one at the end of the song. Line-synced LRC: a blank line stays (as a gap) only when the next line is 4 s or more after it; a gap at 0 when the first line is not blank and starts 4 s in or later. Rust nuvx-core::lyrics (timeline, lrc) and Android (LyricGaps.kt withInstrumentalGaps, LrcLib.parseLrc) must agree. end null means the end is unknown.

timed.name: a short intro gets no gap
an intro of 4 s gets a gap at 0
a 4 s break gets a gap at the line's end
a break just under 4 s gets none
no gap after a line whose end is unknown
background vocals move the gap to where they end
no gap at the end of the song

lrc.name: a blank line before a 4 s break stays, and a late first line gets an intro gap
a blank line before a short break is dropped
no intro gap before a first line under 4 s
